title: Choose review scope from a compact dropdown

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-418#review-scope-dropdown (plan 878), revision c287e9b66e00b9201889b35f1d632b1fd1199329 (implementation 392ecc8c4)

Verdict: Caught.
Promise: "Choose by the existing session identity so label similarity or title availability cannot change the comparison." Confirming an option in the Review scope dropdown applies that option's own session comparison.

Next proof action: none for this promise on the paths below. The maintained assertions catch a sibling-key commit in the phone-width long-title tap journey and in the desktop keyboard/pointer chooseScope journey. No repair was planned before this probe, and the probe calls for none.

Fault (validated, used as suggested): dashboard/src/IntentScopeSelect.tsx onCommit. The chosen option's id resolves to the first session whose label shares its first two words (label.split(" ").slice(0, 2)), and that sibling's key is committed. A temporary console.log("IC-PROBE chosen=… committed=…") was the independent witness. Fixtures and assertions were unchanged.

Checkout: isolated detached worktree at c287e9b66 with its own npm ci, clean before the probe. The execution checkout was not touched.
Command: caffeinate -s -i env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES -u OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_FRONTEND_SPLIT -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR npm run test:dashboard:frontend -- 'intent-(session-scope-titles|story-compare-sessions)' --workers=1

Evidence:
- Baseline: 2 files, 7 tests passed (intent-session-scope-titles.spec.ts:58 and :96; intent-story-compare-sessions.spec.ts:63, :81, :98, :115, :147).
- Faulted: 3 failed, 4 passed. IC-PROBE stdout shows the wrong session committed on the intended path:
  * intent-session-scope-titles.spec.ts:58 (phone width, two long ad hoc titles sharing their opening words; the second is tapped): chosen=published:c408727d… committed=published:e0088751… (a sibling). Caught by expectIntentAt(second, …) in intent-session-review-mount.ts:127 (expect.element(story.scope).toHaveTextContent(chosen)), called at spec line 89. It expected the second title and received the first. This catch comes before the read-UUID assertions at lines 90–91.
  * intent-story-compare-sessions.spec.ts:81 ("a chosen session reviews its own changes by its UUID"): chosen fb24f250…, committed ffa2e78c…. Caught at line 90 (expect.poll(story.summaryText).toContain("Refinement — <second refinement close time>")), which received the first refinement's close time.
  * intent-story-compare-sessions.spec.ts:98 ("Whole story returns from a session…"): caught at line 106. The tree showed ffa2e78c….txt instead of fb24f250….txt.
  * Passing tests logged chosen == committed (:96 untitled single session; :147) or committed nothing (:63, :115). The fault did not cross their paths.
- Restoration: file restored with git checkout and byte-identical to a saved original; git status clean. The rerun of the same command passed 2 files and 7 tests with no IC-PROBE output. The scratch worktree was removed and pruned.

Limits: covers only the paths above: the phone tap with long shared-opening titles, and chooseScope selection among "Refinement — <time>" labels. Keyboard-only confirmation (arrow keys plus Enter) was not faulted separately.

Costs:
- Test runtime (measured, Vitest Duration lines): baseline 3.47 s, faulted 19.45 s, restored 2.68 s; about 25.6 s total. npm ci not measured separately.
- Human effort: unavailable. No human took part in this delegated run.
- Agent effort: unavailable as a supported measure. About 13 tool calls; no token or time accounting was available.
- Invocation-to-report elapsed: 94313 ms (measured), 1795777118894 → 1795777213207 Unix epoch ms.

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision c287e9b66e00b9201889b35f1d632b1fd1199329; verdict Caught; no follow-up.
